title: Jess
html_source: A jess signifies a short strap fastened around each leg of a hawk used in falconry. Is this a reference to the hawk, Ulysses? It appears to be a strap through which the virgin’s wrist holding a parasol is placed. It could be another symbol of constraint as with the “curse of God” corset and suspenders.
